description: Where the Lost Woods' real exits lead, by game position [x, z]. The game's map data (MapParam EntranceAnchor) leaves every Lost Woods exit unnamed; these come from the scene-change objects at the same positions in zeldamods' Owl Object Map (https://objmap-oot.zeldamods.org, FieldAndDungeonEntranceEventRequestActor NextBancParamName). The maze's other doors lead back to Kokiri Forest as wrong turns and aren't listed.
